verdict.rationale: The docs reference a Pulumi Registry whose providers are usable from every supported language, and the GitHub README cites 300+ providers, so consuming from a public registry is evidenced, though only for providers. There is no evidence for publishing your own packages or for reusable higher-level components or modules. Missing for 10: documented publishing workflow to the public registry, evidence of reusable component/module packages (beyond providers), independent or hands-on corroboration of registry consumption.
